headline: A Legend replaces a Legend
dek: The President announces who should succeed the head of Nvidia: the head of Apple. Switzerland has reviewed the request.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend! President DONALD J. TRUMP
original.key: there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend!
original.context: Posted on 12 November 2026. The resignation and the choice of successor are as the President describes them; Nvidia and Apple are private companies whose boards choose their chief executives.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 13 November 2026 (shown as 11/12/26, 7:29 AM Pacific).

en: We note that company bosses are now chosen on Truth Social.
In Switzerland, the government does not even choose its own president. Parliament just rotates it, every year.
